newsitem.title: FRANCE: French weekly protests as Zaire expels journalist.
newsitem.headline: French weekly protests as Zaire expels journalist.

text.p: The French weekly Le Journal du Dimanche protested on Saturday against Zaire's decision to expel one of its journalists just a day after her arrival in the war-ravaged central African state.

"Le Journal du Dimanche wishes to solemnly express its astonishment and its disapproval of these repeated attacks on the free exercise of the profession of journalist," the newspaper said in a letter to Zaire's ambassador to France.
It gave a copy of the letter to Reuters.
Correspondent Karen Lajon arrived in the Zairean capital Kinshasa on Friday with a valid visa and had not broken any rules or laws, the newspaper said.
It was the second time in a month that one of its journalists had been expelled from Zaire.
